definition.dp_pct: dark_pool_volume / (dark_pool_volume + regular_volume) per UW price bucket

definition.windows: 1D = window_end, 1W = last 5 sessions, 1M = last 21 sessions (bucket volumes summed)
definition.snapshots: single sessions: window_end, 5 and 21 sessions earlier
